The '''Instrop sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] regions.

==History==
The sector was terrorized by [[Danaan Kerr]] in the wake of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="WbC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>
